item.title: In South Korea, jail time awaits Halloween police impersonators
item.description: Four years ago, party-goers dressed as police officers were reportedly mistaken for the real thing amid a deadly crowd crush in South Korea’s capital. item.title: Man falls to death fleeing Hong Kong police raid on suspected drug den
item.description: A man has died after falling from a building while trying to flee a Hong Kong police raid on a suspected drug den in Yau Ma Tei. The 42-year-old man, surnamed Kwong, was found unconscious outside 385-387 Reclamation Street at about 9.28pm on Sunday. item.title: Man bitten after being chased by 3 dogs on his way to work in Yuen Long
item.description: A 26-year-old warehouse worker has been injured in Hong Kong after being chased by three dogs and bitten by one of them on his way to work.
